summary: Fictional unsigned Cedar Harbor loan TEST-SL-2026-00482 for Alex Morgan, cosigned by Jordan Morgan. One unsecured fixed-rate private education loan: $25,000 gross, $500 fee, $24,500 net to school. Attendance costs and other aid are not stated.

reportedTotals.source: Sections 1-2, pages 1-2; single private student loan

funding.name: Cedar Harbor private education loan
funding.status: Approved; deferred repayment elected; assumed acceptance August 24, 2026; unsigned fictional specimen
conditions: Education costs certified by the school
Borrower and cosigner each owe the full obligation
Optional automatic-payment discount is not elected

loan.capitalization: $3,187.50 initial school/grace interest capitalizes once March 1, 2028, producing $28,187.50 repayment principal. Initial interest is simple, not monthly compounded. Fees are not capitalized or interest-bearing. Hardship interest capitalizes after each approved period.
loan.inSchoolDeferment: 12 months, September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027; no scheduled payments; $2,125 interest accrues on $25,000. Additional school deferment is not automatic.
loan.gracePeriod: One six-month grace period, September 1, 2027 through February 29, 2028; no scheduled payments; $1,062.50 interest accrues.
loan.cosignerRelease: Review after 24 consecutive, full, on-time principal-and-interest payments, plus degree completion, proof of income and independent credit review. Approval not guaranteed. Deferment months and partial payments do not count.
loan.defaultTerms: Delinquent when not received by due date; default after 90 calendar days unpaid or material intentional misrepresentation. After required notice and cure opportunity, acceleration and permitted collection; borrower and cosigner credit reporting possible.

details.label: Estimated APR
details.value: 8.727%; distinct from the 8.50% interest rate; illustrative nominal annualized cash-flow yield including withheld fee and payment timing, rounded to three decimals

details.label: Interest convention
details.value: 30/360: full month 30 days, year 360 days. Monthly interest = outstanding principal x annual rate / 12; partial-month interest = principal x annual rate x contract days / 360. Begins September 1, 2026.

details.label: Optional automatic-payment discount
details.value: Not elected; 0.25 percentage-point reduction to 8.25%, not 6.375%. Requires enrolled, successful automatic bank withdrawals during active repayment only. No discount during school, grace or hardship deferment. If eligibility ends, base 8.50% returns and future payments are recalculated over the remaining term.

details.label: Lifetime costs
details.value: Total payments $41,938.48; lifetime interest $16,938.48; finance charge $17,438.48 includes the $500 fee. Estimates exclude optional discounts, late charges, returned-payment fees and future hardship periods.

details.label: Payment allocation and prepayment
details.value: Fees, then accrued interest, then principal. No prepayment penalty. Extra payments reduce principal only after fees/interest and do not replace the next installment. Unless revised in writing, monthly payments remain due and early principal reduction shortens payoff. Payoff quotes include interest through requested date.

details.label: Late fee
details.value: Lesser of 5% of unpaid installment portion or $25 once more than 15 calendar days overdue; one late fee per installment. Full $349.48 overdue: $17.47; $100 unpaid: $5. Threshold is not interest-free and does not change due date.

details.label: Other fees
details.value: Returned payment $20 each, separate from late fees; application fee $0; prepayment penalty $0. Collection costs must be actual, reasonable, documented external expenses as permitted by law; no fixed percentage.

details.label: Hardship forbearance
details.value: Discretionary documented hardship; up to three months per approval, six months lifetime. Payments pause only after written approval. Base-rate interest continues and capitalizes at each approved period end. No separate fee. Payments are recalculated to preserve original maturity and can increase. Excluded from estimates.

deadlines.action: Written cancellation must be received to cancel loan and fee before funding

disbursements.term: Single disbursement; no additional scheduled disbursements

repaymentAssumptions.assumptions: Includes $2,125 school interest and $1,062.50 grace interest, capitalized March 1, 2028. All payments on time; no further borrowing, early repayment, hardship pause or automatic-payment discount. Internal precision retained; cents displayed; monthly servicing rounding may differ by a few cents.

repaymentPlans.assumptions: 119 payments of $349.48 from April 1, 2028 through February 1, 2038; final payment $350.36 March 1, 2038. Lifetime interest includes initial school/grace interest. Final installment adjusts for rounded regular payments. Optional discount not elected.

terms.term: Private loan; no automatic federal benefits
terms.explanation: No federal income-driven repayment, Public Service Loan Forgiveness or government interest subsidy. Hardship relief only from contract or applicable law. No promised discharge for noncompletion or inability to find employment.
Jordan Morgan owes the full debt on the same basis as Alex Morgan; lender need not exhaust borrower collection first, subject to applicable law.

Report graduation, withdrawal or below-half-time enrollment within 30 days. Earlier end than August 31, 2027 starts six-month grace earlier and revises repayment. Additional school deferment not automatic. School refund reduces principal when received; original fee not refunded after cancellation deadline.
Documented requests reviewed individually; no guaranteed contractual discharge. Applicable legal protections control.

Electronic statements to alex.morgan@example.com; keep contact information current. Servicing transfer changes neither contractual rate nor repayment obligations. Disputes identify account, amount and reason and do not suspend valid payment obligations. No mandatory arbitration clause.

rightsAndResponsibilities.text: Written cancellation received by August 28, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time cancels loan and fee before funding.
Prepay without penalty; request conditional hardship or cosigner-release review without guaranteed approval.
Borrower and cosigner each repay full principal, accrued interest and permitted charges; keep paying valid obligations during disputes.
Report graduation, withdrawal or below-half-time enrollment within 30 days; keep contact information current.

sections.title: Disbursement & interest terms

details.label: Assumed acceptance event
details.value: August 24, 2026; historical scenario event, not the August 25 acceptance deadline. Dates are invented contractual test terms.

sections.title: Repayment schedule & cost
sections.summary: Clauses 5-7: 12 school months and six grace months; $3,187.50 capitalized March 1, 2028; $28,187.50 entering repayment. One 120-payment schedule including initial school/grace interest; payment allocation and prepayment conditions retained.

sections.title: Fees, hardship & default
sections.summary: Clauses 8-11: fees; discretionary hardship up to three months per approval/six lifetime; base-rate accrual and capitalization, original maturity preserved with possible payment increase; 90-day default; no automatic federal benefits.

sections.title: Cosigner & servicing provisions
sections.summary: Clauses 12-16: full cosigner liability and conditional release after 24 qualifying payments; enrollment reporting, refunds, individual death/disability review without guaranteed discharge; electronic servicing, disputes and unsigned specimen. No debt created.
